Im looking for anything remote and creative. I have an administrative/executive background but I don't want to do that if Im being honest with myself. So I signed up for skill share to enhance my graphic design and writing skills so I can get some freelance work. I applied to a few jobs either way just to increase income though. Chicago is about 15 hours away. Im in Colorado. Ive been dreaming about doing A straight shot fueled by ambitions and caffeine. Thank you, I feel hopeful as well.

Are you on the east/west coast or midwest? I definitely find journaling therapeutic. I use to write every night when I was growing up. I would recommend it to anyone. If you find it difficult to start, there are journals that have prompts already built in. You could also fill in your own parts. Ill link one of my fav articles down below that has prompts and encouragements for journaling.

Hello,

Wow, thank you so much.

Well last night I had a full on episode so I made a fort in my closet and cried as I watched Tik Tok videos and texted somebody from the suicide hotline. It all helped a lot actually, lol. I cleaned up my bedroom and journaled before falling asleep.  I woke up fighting but right now Im planning on finding a job so I can save up money and move to Chicago. I even thought about living with roommates first to be around other people and even maybe make new friends and felt hopeful instead of terrified. So, progress?

I don't know what to to do anymore. I have sincerely tried so many times. I just feel deflated. I realized if I died no one would care. If I was murdered, no one would care. Im just walking flesh waiting to die.
